months.note: 봄과 가을에 중부 이북을 지나가며, 번식지에서는 5월 중순~6월에 알을 낳는다.

summary: 봄과 가을에 한반도 중부 이북에 드물게 나타나는 길잃은새로, 숲속에서 번식한다. 홀로 또는 암수가 함께 지내며 곤충을 주로 먹지만 장미과 열매도 먹는다. 5월 중순~6월에 한 해 한 번, 한배에 알 4~7개를 낳는다. 시베리아, 알타이, 몽골 북부, 아무르, 우수리에서 번식하고 중국 남부, 하이난섬, 인도차이나, 인도, 말레이반도 등지에서 겨울을 난다.

art.subject: Red-breasted Flycatcher (Ficedula parva), adult male, as seen on spring or autumn migration: forehead, crown, nape, back and rump uniform grey-brown; uppertail coverts dark brown; lores, cheeks, ear-coverts and neck sides ash-grey; a narrow dull white eye-ring; chin, throat and upper breast orange-red, bordered by grey on the breast sides and flanks; lower breast and belly creamy white; wings dark brown with narrow pale fringes; tail blackish with large white patches at the base of the outer feathers. Bill dark brown with a pale pinkish base to the lower mandible; dark brown iris; slender dark legs.
art.pose: perched on a low branch in the forest, side view
art.scene: forest in central or northern Korea during spring or autumn migration; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, side view perched: uniform grey-brown crown and back, ash-grey face, breast sides and flanks, dull white eye-ring, orange-red chin, throat and upper breast, creamy belly, dark brown wings with narrow pale fringes, slender dark legs
adult female, side view perched: grey-brown upperparts slightly browner than the male's, plain buff-white throat and breast without orange, dull white eye-ring, blackish tail with white basal patches
art.build: Tiny flycatcher, about 11 cm, smaller than a sparrow, round-headed with a rather large dark eye. Bill short, flat and broad-based, triangular when seen from above, much shorter than the head. Legs short, thin, dark. Wings short, the wingtips reaching just past the base of the tail. Tail fairly long, often cocked and flicked open to flash the white patches. Perches low in forest shade and drops to catch insects.
avoid: Do not paint jet-black uppertail coverts, an all-black bill and orange only on the chin and throat; those mark Taiga Flycatcher (Ficedula albicilla).
Do not paint the whole underparts orange like a robin; the orange is limited to the throat and upper breast.
Do not leave out the white patches at the base of the outer tail feathers.
